title: Owner-auth policy
description: The owner-auth policy (F1c): which signals mark a worker environment (bin/worker_env.py), which owner-authenticator providers exist and which proofs each action needs (bin/owner_auth.py). Owner-only and identity-critical: only the owner path writes it.

worker_signals.description: Any one signal makes this process a worker environment: every owner command refuses, and the event writer sends its line to the untrusted stream (F1c B4, B7). These add to the role table's worker_markers and roles.py prove.

token_env.description: Environment variables that carry an agent token: set and not empty = a worker.

users.description: OS user names agents run as (empty until E1 adds the agent user).

sandbox_files.description: Absolute paths whose existence marks the agent sandbox.

worktree_dirs.description: Folders (relative to the stack root) whose sub-folders are run worktrees: a process whose working folder lies in one is a worker.
